items.title: 該「賣記憶體、買光通訊」？美光遭砍目標價掀賣壓、祥茂光電財報引爆AI光互連行情
paras: 美國股市上週五（7 日）出現一場罕見的類股對決。記憶體概念股全面走軟，光通訊供應鏈卻反向噴出，兩大陣營的表現差異之大，也讓一場「賣記憶體、買光通訊」的交易策略在週末投資圈掀起激辯。
導火線是花旗證券分析師 Atif Malik 發布的最新報告。儘管花旗仍維持美光科技 (MU-US) 「買進」評等，卻將目標價從 1400 美元大砍至 1150 美元。
花旗指出，經與記憶體供應鏈上下游業者交叉查證後研判，DRAM 與 NAND 價格漲勢將在未來四季逐步收斂，並可能於明年 5 月見頂。
報告中花旗進一步預估，未來四個季度 DRAM 價格季增率將依序放緩至 23%、9%、2% 與 0%，2027 下半年甚至可能轉為季減 3%；NAND 方面的季增率則預估為 29%、7%、0% 與 - 1%，下半年跌幅可能擴大至 5%。
花旗將這波降溫歸咎於中國記憶體廠長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 與長江存儲持續擴產所帶來的供給壓力。
受此消息影響，美光股價週五下跌約 1%，SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 重挫逾 2%。跌勢並蔓延至亞股，南韓 SK 海力士 (000660KS) 重挫逾 4%，三星電子 (005930KS) 與日商鎧俠也同步走低。

祥茂光電財報亮眼 光通訊族群集體噴發

與記憶體股形成強烈對比的，是光通訊模組廠祥茂光電 (AAOI-US) 交出亮眼成績單引發光通訊板塊的集體走強。
祥茂光電第二季營收年增 86%，達 1.919 億美元，其中資料中心業務營收首度突破億元大關；非 GAAP 每股純益 0.06 美元，優於財測上緣。
公司並上修財測，預估第三季營收將落在 2.55 億至 2.90 億美元區間，全年目標維持約 11 億美元不變。
消息激勵下，光通訊族群同步走強。康寧 (GLW-US) 股價上漲 5%，Lumentum(LITE-US) 上漲 6%，Coherent(COHR-US) 更是狂飆 13%，祥茂光電本身也大漲 9%。
從產品結構觀察，祥茂光電第二季 400G 產品營收達 4840 萬美元，年增逾四倍；更值得留意的是 800G 產品，單季營收 1280 萬美元，不僅年增逾十倍，季增幅度也達一倍，管理層更預告第三季 800G 營收將較上季再成長近五倍，顯示市場需求正快速從 100G、400G 等舊世代規格，轉向更高速率的新產品。
產能吃緊的訊號同樣明顯。祥茂光電管理層透露，目前客戶下單需求已超出公司實際供應能力達 20% 至 40%，換言之，制約公司成長的已非市場需求，而是產能瓶頸。
目前 800G 與 1.6T 產品月產能已逼近 20 萬片，公司規劃到 2026 年底擴大至 65 萬片以上，2027 年底則要突破 93 萬片。
祥茂光電執行長林誌明更樂觀預期，第四季 1.6T 產品營收可望超過 7000 萬美元，「就算明年首季再翻一倍，我也不會意外」。
不過他同時坦言，1.6T 所需的關鍵零組件 DSP 與 TIA 供應仍相當吃緊，第四季出貨的主要瓶頸來自零組件供應，而非公司自身產能。
市場分析人士認為，祥茂光電這份優於預期的財報，也為即將公布財報的 Lumentum 與 Coherent 注入信心。這兩家公司同樣獲輝達 (NVDA-US) 入股加持，被市場視為 AI 算力基建浪潮下的「賣鏟人」代表。

記憶體多頭陣營內部分裂 周末論戰白熱化

真正引爆週末討論熱度的，是向來看多記憶體股的 Citrini Research 分析師 Jukan 在社群平台 X 上的一篇貼文。
他提出短期內市場或許該考慮「賣記憶體、買光通訊」的操作邏輯，並列出三項理由：

南韓槓桿型 ETF 市場運作機制近期失靈，相關投資人恐面臨贖回壓力，可能對記憶體股帶來額外賣壓；
輝達正調整下一代 AI 系統架構，傳出新款 Rubin Ultra 晶片可能減少每機櫃搭載的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）數量，轉而仰賴光互連技術串接多個機櫃；
市場對記憶體價格將在未來兩季見頂的預期正持續升溫。


值得注意的是，Jukan 強調自己對記憶體股的長期看法仍屬正面，僅是短期轉趨謹慎。
他認為，AI 基礎建設的投資重心正從單純堆疊 HBM 容量，轉向講究資料中心整體架構效率，而高速光互連正是這波轉型的關鍵環節。
這番言論隨即引來活躍於社群媒體 X 的匿名 AI 與半導體供應鏈研究員、投資人 Serenity 的正面反駁，他重申自己仍堅定「看多」記憶體族群。
Serenity 的核心論點在於：真正改變的是股價，而非基本面。
他指出，Coherent 與 Lumentum 的雷射元件早在 7 月股價重挫時，未來兩年產能便已銷售一空；祥茂光電供需失衡的狀況，其實在上一季法說會上便已明確揭露，換言之整個 7 月暴跌期間，這些公司的基本面未曾惡化，「變的只是清算賣壓過後的股價」。
他也諷刺，不少投資人在祥茂光電股價跌到 75 美元時直呼是「騙局一場」，如今股價漲到 140 美元卻又轉向看多，「但光收發器與磷化銦基板的產能瓶頸根本沒變，情況甚至可能更嚴重」。
至於記憶體股，Serenity 觀察到近期出現大量散戶恐慌性拋售，但他反問，「同樣是這批人，一個月前不是還在為美光簽下 16 份供應合約、三星繳出歷史新高的營業利益歡呼喝采嗎？」
他認為，輝達針對 Rubin Ultra 進行的儲存配置優化，不過是該公司每一代產品都會進行的例行調整，而當前記憶體類股市值相對其營業利益水準而言「明顯偏低到不合理」，尤其在記憶體需求逐漸轉為結構性成長的背景下，明年供需失衡的情況恐怕只會更加嚴峻。
Serenity 在貼文中總結道：「祥茂光電在 140 美元和 75 美元時，都是同一家公司；三星市值 1.5 兆美元和 9800 億美元時，也還是同一家公司。真正改變的只有估值與市場敘事，而這通常只是雜訊，市場不過是在類股之間輪動而已。」

items.title: 美國政府「不會」允許市場崩盤？美銀Hartnett「短空長多」、點牛市終結「兩訊號」
items.title_en: U.S. Government Won't Let Markets Crash? BofA's Hartnett Calls for Short-Term Shorts, Long-Term Longs, and Flags Two Signals Ending the Bull Market
paras: 美銀策略師哈奈特（Michael Hartnett）對美股後市給出「短空長多」判斷，認為市場情緒已過度亢奮，信用市場也浮現警訊，短線宜降低風險部位；但他同時強調，只要美國決策當局持續將股市視為「大到不能倒」的系統性資產，長線做多股票、放空債券的策略便不會改變，並認為「殖利率走高、銀行股下跌」才是本輪牛市真正反轉的關鍵訊號。
哈奈特在最新一期「Flow Show」報告中指出，這波牛市之所以難以被撼動，關鍵在於美國經濟已高度仰賴股市所帶動的財富效應。
美國家庭今年以來股票資產已增值 7 兆美元，延續 2024 與 2025 年各增加 9 兆美元的走勢，加上 AI 資料中心資本支出熱潮，共同構成當局不願、也不敢坐視股市重挫的結構性理由。
他並提到，上週外匯市場出現協調式干預、平息一場他稱之為「窮人版 LTCM」的去槓桿賣壓，正是美國政府隨時準備出手護盤的最新證明，且川普政府與財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）手中仍握有殖利率曲線控制這項政策工具作為後盾。
不過，哈奈特並未因此轉為全面樂觀。他觀察到，受高收益債券大規模資金流入、全球高收益債及 AT1 風險債券利差收窄，以及全球股票指數廣度改善等因素驅動，美銀牛熊指標已從 9.4 升至 9.7，創下 2021 年迷因股狂潮以來新高。
哈奈特指出，歷史上每當美銀牛熊指標觸及類似極值，無論是 2018 年、2020 年還是 2021 年，市場情緒往往在此後一年內從極度樂觀迅速逆轉至極度悲觀。
儘管他並未斷言歷史必然重演，但明確提示這一規律值得警惕。
基於這項判斷，哈奈特在戰術操作上仍主張「夏季撤退與資產輪動」，建議資金轉向必需消費品等防禦型類股，以及 REITs、小型股、生技股等對利率較敏感的存續期資產，並提高美元部位。
他解釋，這類資產較能承受金融環境收緊的衝擊，一旦「總體經濟不衰退、聯準會不升息、AI 資本支出不縮減、期中選舉不過度躁進」這套市場普遍押注的樂觀劇本落空，受到的傷害也會比銀行、工業與半導體等景氣循環類股輕。
在宏觀數據層面，哈奈特先前亦預判，若 7 月非農就業人數超過 12.5 萬且失業率低於 4.1%，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）可能在 8 月 28 日 Jackson Hole 全球央行年會上重回鷹派立場；而若非農數據低於 5 萬且失業率超過 4.3%，則將利期資產和防禦性配置。
最終公佈的數據呈現出混合訊號。非農業數據大幅不及預期，但失業率降至 4.1%，部分抵消了負面衝擊，儘管勞動力人口在同一時期萎縮了 26.4 萬人。
至於這波牛市真正終結的關鍵訊號，哈奈特亦給出明確答案:「殖利率上升、銀行股下跌」。
他警告，一旦債券市場出現「殖利率走高、美元走弱」的債券自衛式拋售，迫使財政政策緊急轉向，並帶動資金從股票轉向債券，繁榮格局便可能劃下句點。
哈奈特也點出信用市場的隱憂。AI 超大規模資料中心營運商的信用利差與 CDS 持續走闊，主因企業回購動能減弱，唯有科技七巨頭本季每股盈餘總和超過 70 美元，才能化解「中國低價算力終結 AI 資本支出熱潮」的疑慮。
報告最後，哈奈特將視角拉高至政治經濟框架。
他指出，2020 年代民粹主義浪潮推動財政擴張，使美國名目 GDP 六年間成長 63% 至 32 兆美元，美國國債規模也將突破 40 兆美元。
哈奈特將即將到來的期中選舉定調為「以成長降赤字」與「以財富稅降赤字」兩條路線之爭。
他認為，若共和黨保住參議院多數席次將是利多，做多消費股是押注川普政府轉向聚焦民生可負擔性，而做多黃金則是對沖選民結構「K 型分化」風險、避免年底前殖利率、美元與股市同步重挫的有效工具。
paras_en: BofA strategist Michael Hartnett judges the U.S. equity outlook as "short-term short, long-term long," believing market sentiment is overly exuberant and credit markets are showing warning signs, so short‑term risk should be reduced; however, he stresses that as long as U.S. policymakers continue to treat the stock market as a systemically important asset that "cannot fail," a strategy of buying stocks for the long run and shorting bonds will remain unchanged, and he sees "rising yields and falling bank stocks" as the true reversal signal for this bull run.
Hartnett notes in the latest "Flow Show" report that the resilience of the current bull market hinges on the U.S. economy’s heavy reliance on the wealth effect generated by equities.

U.S. households have seen their stock holdings increase by $7 trillion so far this year, continuing a trend of $9 trillion gains in both 2024 and 2025, and together with the AI data‑center capital‑expenditure boom provides a structural reason why authorities are unwilling—and unable—to stand by a sharp market decline.

He adds that last week coordinated FX intervention quelled a de‑leveraging sell‑off he dubbed a "poor‑man’s LTCM," which he sees as fresh proof that the U.S. government is ready to step in, and that the Trump administration and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent still hold yield‑curve control as a policy backstop.

Nevertheless, Hartnett is not wholly optimistic. He observes that massive inflows into high‑yield bonds, narrowing spreads on global high‑yield and AT1 risk bonds, and an improving breadth of global equity indices have pushed BofA’s bull‑bear index from 9.4 to 9.7, a peak not seen since the meme‑stock frenzy of 2021.

Hartnett points out that historically, whenever the BofA bull‑bear index reaches such extreme levels—whether in 2018, 2020 or 2021—market sentiment typically flips from extreme optimism to extreme pessimism within a year.
While he does not claim history must repeat itself, he warns that this pattern deserves close attention.

Based on this view, Hartnett still recommends a "summer retreat and asset rotation" tactically, shifting capital toward defensive sectors such as consumer staples, as well as REITs, small‑caps and biotech—assets more sensitive to interest‑rate duration—and increasing dollar exposure.

He explains that these assets can better withstand a tightening financial environment, and if the broadly‑bet optimistic script—no recession, no Fed rate hikes, sustained AI cap‑ex, and a calm midterm election—fails, they would suffer less than cyclical stocks like banks, industrials and semiconductors.

On the macro side, Hartnett previously forecast that if July non‑farm payrolls exceed 125,000 and unemployment falls below 4.1%, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh could revert to a hawkish stance at the August 28 Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium; conversely, if payrolls are under 50,000 and unemployment rises above 4.3%, investors should tilt toward rate‑sensitive and defensive holdings.

The actual data delivered mixed signals: non‑farm payrolls fell far short of expectations, but the unemployment rate dropped to 4.1%, partially offsetting the downside, even as the labor‑force participation declined by 264,000 in the same period.
Regarding the decisive signal that the bull market is truly ending, Hartnett states plainly: "Rising yields and falling bank stocks."

He warns that if the bond market initiates a self‑defensive sell‑off—higher yields and a weaker dollar—forcing fiscal policy to shift abruptly and prompting a flow from equities to bonds, the prosperity cycle could be capped.

Hartnett also highlights a credit‑market concern: credit spreads and CDS on ultra‑large AI data‑center operators are widening because corporate buybacks are slowing, and only if the seven major tech firms collectively post earnings above $70 per share this quarter can the worry that "low‑cost Chinese compute will end the AI cap‑ex boom" be allayed.
In the report’s final section, Hartnett lifts the perspective to a political‑economic framework.
He notes that the populist wave of the 2020s has driven fiscal expansion, boosting nominal U.S. GDP by 63% to $32 trillion over six years, while sovereign debt is set to surpass $40 trillion.
Hartnett frames the upcoming midterm elections as a contest between two deficit‑reduction paths: "growth‑driven deficit reduction" versus "wealth‑tax‑driven deficit reduction."

He believes that if Republicans retain a Senate majority it will be bullish, as going long on consumer stocks bets on a Trump administration refocusing on affordable living, while going long on gold hedges the "K‑shaped" voter‑base risk and protects against a simultaneous plunge in yields, the dollar and equities before year‑end.

items.title: 〈台股盤前要聞〉拚重回4萬5大關、MSCI 本周季度調整、處置股提前出關
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Pre-Market News: Striving to Return to 45,000, MSCI Quarterly Adjustment, and Disposal Stock Early Release
paras:
8/10 台股盤前要聞

1. 美股四大指數上周五 (7 日) 收紅，費半指數大漲 2.56%，台指期上漲 736 點，. 以 45033 點作收，提前站上 4 萬 5 大關；台股 8 月首周大漲 1106 點後，本周將迎來 MSCI 季度調整，以及處置股新制正式周一 (10 日) 正式實施、以及台股 7 月營收及半年報陸續公布下，有望展開進一步反彈。
2.MSCI 台股權重季度調整預定 13 日凌晨公布，投顧點名，記憶體族群南亞科、華邦電、群聯，以及 ABF 載板廠景碩等 4 檔個股，有機會入列成分股；台股 7 月下跌 3006 點，出現轉弱，市值一個月內由 4.6 兆美元降至至 4.3 兆美元，台股權重有可能出現小幅調降。
3. 證交所公告，修正後的「公布或通知注意交易資訊暨處置作業要點」將於周一 (10 日) 正式實施。新制針對處置天數、撮合間隔以及注意股票門檻進行大幅度調整，現行仍在處置期間的個股將全面適用新規定，包含禾伸堂、大量、台勝科、愛普 * 等 9 檔個股處置期提前於 8 月 7 日結束，8/10 起恢復正常交易；而南電也可提前至 8/11 出關 (原為 8/18)。
4. 伺服器導軌川湖 (2059-TW) 7 日舉行線上法人說明會，執行副總經理兼發言人王俊強針對第二季營運成果進行說明。面對市場震驚於第二季銷貨毛利率衝上 87.42% 與營業利益率 82.08% 的優異表現，王俊強強調這是公司長期沉澱的技術與創新爆發成果。
5. 致新 (8081-TW) 7 日召開法說會，董事長吳錦川表示，目前半導體供應鏈缺貨情況已回到類似 2020 至 2021 年疫情期間的狀態，雖然造成缺貨的原因不同，但對 IC 設計公司而言，現階段最重要的已不是漲價幅度或毛利率，而是「能不能拿到更多 Wafer」。
6. 伺服器機殼廠勤誠 (8210-TW) 7 日召開法說會，執行長陳亞男表示，第三季機櫃與機櫃零組件業務上，POC 與 NPI 雙引擎同步發動，看好第三季維持穩健向上，認為下半年營運將先蹲後跳並迎來旺季。另外，勤誠董事會也通過越南新廠投資案，預計今年第四季至明年第一季投產。

paras_en: On August 10, the Taiwan stock market pre-market news reported that the US stock market's four major indexes closed higher on Friday (7th), with the Nasdaq index surging 2.56%. The Taiwan stock market also rose, with the Taiwan Weighted Index closing at 45,033 points, surpassing the 45,000 mark. The market is expected to further rebound this week with the MSCI quarterly adjustment and the implementation of new disposal stock regulations.

The MSCI Taiwan stock weight quarterly adjustment is scheduled to be announced on the 13th. According to market analysts, memory-related stocks such as Nanya Technology, Winbond, and ASE, as well as ABF Substrate manufacturer Jingsheng, may be included in the constituent stocks. However, due to the decline in the Taiwan stock market in July, the market value has decreased from $4.6 trillion to $4.3 trillion, which may lead to a slight decrease in the weight of Taiwan stocks.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange announced that the revised 'Trading Information and Disposal Operation Guidelines' will be implemented on Monday (10th). The new regulations make significant adjustments to the disposal period, matching interval, and attention stock threshold. Stocks currently in the disposal period, including those of Hotai Motor, will be subject to the new regulations, and their disposal periods will end on August 7th, with normal trading resuming on August 10th.

Server rail manufacturer Chiah Chyun (2059-TW) held an online investor conference on the 7th, where Executive Vice President and Spokesperson Wang Junqiang explained the company's second-quarter operating results. In response to the market's surprise at the company's second-quarter sales gross margin of 87.42% and operating profit margin of 82.08%, Wang emphasized that this was the result of the company's long-term accumulation of technology and innovation.

Zhen Ding Technology (8081-TW) held an investor conference on the 7th, where Chairman Wu Jinchuan stated that the current semiconductor supply chain shortage has returned to a state similar to that during the 2020-2021 pandemic. Although the causes of the shortage are different, for IC design companies, the most important thing at present is not the price increase or gross margin, but whether they can get more wafers.

Server chassis manufacturer Kingchamp (8210-TW) held an investor conference on the 7th, where Executive Director Chen Yanan stated that in the third quarter, the company's cabinet and cabinet component business will be driven by two engines, POC and NPI, and is expected to maintain a stable upward trend. The company also approved a new factory investment in Vietnam, which is expected to start production in the fourth quarter of this year or the first quarter of next year.

The Taiwan stock market is expected to be affected by the MSCI quarterly adjustment, which may lead to a slight decrease in the weight of Taiwan stocks. The Taiwan Weighted Index has returned to the 45,000 mark, and the market is watching the adjustment.
The Taiwan dollar depreciated against the US dollar, once falling below the 32.3 threshold, and closed at 32.288 yuan, ending its two-day rising streak.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange's new regulations on disposal stocks will take effect on August 10th, shortening the disposal period and changing the matching interval to 2 minutes. Ten listed stocks, including those of Hotai Motor, will be released from disposal ahead of schedule.
Huahong Pharmaceutical updated its AOP arbitration case, and the second phase of the results is being discussed, with a proposal to withdraw the arbitration judgment.
Wistron's first-half earnings exceeded 15 times its capital, a record high for the same period. The company's capital expenditure in the second half of the year is expected to reach $942 million.
Chiah Chyun's second-quarter gross margin was surprisingly high, with Executive Vice President Wang Junqiang attributing it to the company's extreme management and IP value.

Kingchamp's Executive Director Chen Yanan stated that the demand for AI will drive the company's growth in the second half of the year, with a 'dive and jump' trend expected in the fourth quarter. The company's new factory in Vietnam is expected to start production in the fourth quarter.

Taiwan's exports in July reached $7.53 billion, the third-highest on record. The market is watching the export performance in August, which is expected to challenge the longest 34-day streak, with a full-year target of $80 billion.
Zhen Ding Technology stated that the PMIC shortage has returned to a state similar to that during the pandemic, and the increase in wafer supply will be limited next year.
ASE's revenue in July was NT$27.162 billion, a new high, with a year-over-year increase of 263% in the first seven months.
TSMC's second-half operations are expected to be strong, but the company warned to be cautious of the inflection point in demand.

items.title: Citrini點名「6檔」AI資安股！AI代理爆發掀資安需求  誰將成最大贏家？
items.title_en: Citrini Names Six AI Cyber‑Security Stocks! AI Agents Spark Surge in Security Demand – Who Will Be the Biggest Winner?
paras: 曾因提出人工智慧（AI）末日衝擊預測而爆紅的市場研究機構 Citrini Research，如今將目光轉向資安產業，認為隨著 AI 代理（AI agent）技術快速普及，企業對資安防護的需求將大幅攀升，資安類股可望成為這波 AI 浪潮下的最大受惠者之一。
根據《Business Insider》報導，Citrini 在最新報告中指出，AI 技術演進速度之快，讓企業比以往任何時候都更迫切需要強化網路防禦系統。
報告直言，多數資安業者正迎來「難得的擴張契機」，客戶端預算明顯轉向資訊安全領域，但與此同時，AI 也帶來另一項隱憂，即恐讓部分資安服務淪為可被輕易取代的「商品化」產品。
事實上，早在 2025 年便有資安專家預言，地緣政治緊張局勢將促使美國加碼投資網路安全。
Citrini 認為，這樣的趨勢如今已在 AI 浪潮中獲得印證，並舉出 OpenAI 旗下模型日前遭質疑入侵 Hugging Face 系統一事為例，說明 AI 技術本身已成為資安風險的來源之一。
Citrini 進一步指出：「短期而言，AI 將掀起一波網路安全熱潮，因為 AI 模型將挖掘出大量既有漏洞，惡意攻擊者的能力也將獲得大幅強化；與此同時，AI 加速軟體開發的速度，也將使軟體的複雜度與攻擊面擴張得比 AI 消除威脅的速度更快。」
在這樣的判斷下，Citrini 點名了六檔預期將受惠於 AI 驅動資安需求成長的個股，包括：

F5 公司 (FFIV-US) ：年初至今上漲 61%
Zscaler 公司 (ZS-US) ：年初至今下跌 24%
Fortinet(FTNT-US) ：年初至今上漲 105%
Netskope(NTSK-US) ：年初至今下跌 19%
Cloudflare 公司 (NET-US) ：年初至今上漲 58%
Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) ：年初至今上漲 99%


其中多檔個股其實早在上月的分析報告中便已被 Citrini 點名看好，認為它們很可能成為下一階段 AI 的贏家。
然而，該機構坦言，原先預估的產業趨勢演變速度，如今看來比預期還要快上許多。
就個股表現而言，Citrini 認為 F5 雖然在對外行銷上，未能充分凸顯自身在 AI 時代的領先地位，但憑藉其在「硬體原生資安」領域的高度佈局，仍是該機構的首選標的之一。
對於其首選名單中的其他幾檔網路安全股，Citrini 認為，隨著「零信任網路存取」（Zero Trust Network Access，ZTNA）逐漸成為市場焦點，相關企業將迎來投資機會。
這套資安模式的核心理念是，所有 AI 代理程式、裝置與使用者都必須經過驗證。自 OpenAI 旗下 Hugging Face 遭駭事件後，ZTNA 的重要性更加受到關注。
Citrini 認為，這起事件證明，隨著 AI 代理程式日益普及，市場需要進一步強化隱私與安全控管。
該公司表示：「按照這套邏輯，Cloudflare、Zscaler 與 Netskope 等 ZTNA 供應商，可能是整個網路安全產業中受惠於 AI 最為顯著的企業。AI 代理程式大量增加，代表需要監控的連線數量也會同步攀升，將直接有利於這些公司的業務。」
Citrini 進一步指出，Palo Alto Networks 與 Fortinet 都處於網路安全與 AI 兩大趨勢交會的有利位置。
兩家公司不僅能受惠於不斷升溫的資安需求，同時也都擁有某種短期內不太可能被 AI 取代的網路安全「執行層」基礎設施，因此相對不容易受到 AI 顛覆。
paras_en: Citrini Research, the market‑research firm that went viral for predicting an AI‑driven apocalypse, is now turning its focus to the cyber‑security sector, arguing that as AI‑agent technology spreads rapidly, corporate demand for security protection will rise sharply, making cyber‑security stocks one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI wave.
According to Business Insider, Citrini’s latest report says the speed of AI advancement makes companies more urgent than ever to strengthen their network defenses.

The report bluntly states that many cyber‑security vendors are facing a "rare expansion opportunity," with client budgets clearly shifting toward information security, but it also warns that AI could turn some security services into easily replaceable "commoditized" products.
In fact, back in 2025 cyber‑security experts warned that heightened geopolitical tensions would push the United States to increase its investment in network security.

Citrini believes that this trend is now being confirmed within the AI wave, citing the recent controversy over an OpenAI model allegedly breaching Hugging Face’s system as an example that AI itself has become a source of security risk.

Citrini further notes: "In the short term, AI will trigger a wave of cyber‑security activity because AI models will uncover many existing vulnerabilities, greatly enhancing malicious actors’ capabilities; at the same time, AI‑accelerated software development will expand software complexity and attack surfaces faster than AI can mitigate threats."
Based on this assessment, Citrini highlighted six stocks it expects to benefit from AI‑driven security demand growth:

F5 Networks (FFIV‑US): up 61% year‑to‑date; Zscaler (ZS‑US): down 24% YTD; Fortinet (FTNT‑US): up 105% YTD; Netskope (NTSK‑US): down 19% YTD; Cloudflare (NET‑US): up 58% YTD; Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US): up 99% YTD. Several of these were already singled out in Citrini’s analysis last month as likely winners in the next AI phase.
However, the firm admits that the pace of industry‑trend evolution is now much faster than originally expected.

Regarding individual performance, Citrini says that although F5 has not fully highlighted its AI‑era leadership in its marketing, its strong positioning in "hardware‑native security" still makes it one of the firm’s top picks.
For the other top network‑security stocks, Citrini believes that as Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) becomes a market focus, related companies will see investment opportunities.
The core idea of ZTNA is that all AI agents, devices and users must be verified. After the OpenAI‑backed Hugging Face breach, the importance of ZTNA has drawn even more attention.
Citrini says the incident proves that as AI agents become more widespread, the market needs to further strengthen privacy and security controls.

The firm states: "Following this logic, ZTNA providers such as Cloudflare, Zscaler and Netskope could be the most benefited companies in the entire cyber‑security industry from AI. The massive increase in AI agents means the number of connections to monitor will rise accordingly, directly boosting these companies' businesses."
Citrini further points out that Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet are well positioned at the intersection of network security and AI trends.

Both companies not only stand to gain from the heating up of security demand, but also own certain network‑security "execution‑layer" infrastructure that is unlikely to be replaced by AI in the short term, making them relatively resistant to AI disruption.

paras_en: U.S. major indices closed higher last Friday (the 7th), with the Nasdaq soaring 2.56%. Taiwan futures rose 736 points to finish at 45,033, briefly crossing the 45,000 threshold. Analysts highlighted four stocks—memory‑chip makers Nanya Technology, Winbond Electronics, Phison Electronics, and ABF‑listed carrier board maker Jingsheng—that could be added to the index. Taiwan’s Taishin Securities chief economist Huang Wen‑qing said that, overall, the outlook looks better as the US‑China conflict may reach an agreement or at least pause, limiting short‑term escalation. Moreover, the U.S. Labor Department reported a surprising drop in July non‑farm payrolls, prompting expectations that the Fed’s September rate‑hike odds have fallen. Although the S&P 500 hit a record high, strong AI earnings could keep U.S. equities climbing and, in turn, buoy Taiwan’s market.
Regarding the market’s leading sectors, Huang advised investors to keep an eye on AI‑focused stocks as well as related themes such as semiconductor equipment, materials, server rails and AI servers.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange has revised its rules on disposal‑stock handling. The new regime will significantly tighten the allowed holding period, matching intervals and stock‑price thresholds, and will be implemented starting Monday, August 10.

Huang added that the exchange’s and OTC market’s new measures to relax disposal restrictions and shorten the time stocks are locked down should improve trading flow. He expects the changes to boost market activity and volume, providing a positive lift to Taiwan’s future market trajectory.

Foreign investors’ net‑buy activity over the past week was led by several ETFs: Unified Active 50 (00403A‑TW) bought 236,000 shares, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW) bought 225,000, Unified Active Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW) bought 164,000, KGI Taiwan TOP50 (009816‑TW) bought 148,000, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW) bought 118,000, Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) bought 116,000, and Fuhua Future 50 (00991A) bought 87,000. Among the top ten net‑buyers, the majority were active, passive and inverse ETFs.

items.title: 「席勒本益比」飆破42顯示美股恐崩盤？高盛：未來10年仍有7%報酬
items.title_en: S&P Shiller P/E Surpasses 42, Hinting at US Stock Crash? Goldman Sachs: 7% Returns Expected Over Next Decade
paras: 美股指標「席勒本益比」7 月突破 42，創 2000 年網路泡沫高峰以來新高，讓市場擔憂未來報酬恐大幅降溫。不過，專家提醒，高估值不等於股市即將崩盤，企業利潤率持續改善、AI 等產業結構轉變，都可能讓估值維持高檔更久，投資人真正需要警惕的，或許不是「高估值」，而是高估值背後的基本面能否持續支撐。
根據《Business Insider》報導，由於歷史上準確預測長期報酬的紀錄，席勒本益比向來受到看空派與主流華爾街策略師的青睞。
研究機構羅森伯格（Rosenberg Research）創辦人、向來立場偏空的羅森伯格（David Rosenberg）就在近日發布的客戶報告中直言，該指標顯示，若排除網路泡沫時期，目前標普 500 指數是「有史以來估值最昂貴」的時期。
幾年前，高盛集團 (GS-US) 前策略師 David Kostin 也曾警告，高企的 「席勒本益比」代表未來 10 年的年化報酬率可能僅有 3%。
分析稱，儘管席勒本益比原本並非設計用來預測短期市場走勢，但市場人士難免聯想到，指標上次觸及相近高點時，正好是股市崩跌的前夕。
報導指出，即便短期內未必爆發系統性風險，但「未來十年報酬近乎掛零」的前景，同樣令投資人不安。
不過，分析人士指出，這項指標並非毫無爭議，其侷限性也讓不少專家對「估值過高必然導致崩盤」的說法持保留態度，投資人或不必過度擔心。
從歷史數據即可看出席勒本益比一個明顯的缺陷，即美股估值長期處於高檔，指數卻屢創新高。
以 2021 年 7 月為例，當時席勒本益比來到 38。根據美國金融學院（The American College of Financial Services）財富管理教授 Michael Finke 2020 年的研究推算，這代表標普 500 未來十年年化報酬應僅有 1% 至 2%。
然而，過去五年間，標普 500 指數累計上漲 73%，換算年化報酬超過 14%，與當初估算的低報酬情境相差甚遠。
分析指出，除非未來爆發足以重創市場的極端事件，將整體平均報酬拉低至 1% 至 2% 區間，否則單純因估值過高而退場觀望，恐怕反而付出高昂的機會成本。
富達投資（Fidelity）2024 年的一份研究報告也支持這項觀點。該報告發現，若以高本益比為起點的十年期間出現不佳報酬，往往是因為期間爆發如二戰或金融海嘯等重大危機所致，而非估值本身必然導致報酬下滑。
分析人士並提醒，除非投資人正好處於退休前十年、或近期即需動用資金，否則多數人毋須過度憂慮估值偏高的問題，長期複利股息效果，往往足以彌補階段性報酬疲弱的影響。
此外，席勒本益比的另一項局限在於「過於仰賴過去」。由於該指標是以當前股價對比過去十年滾動平均獲利計算而成，往往難以即時反映市場結構的重大轉變。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 便是典型案例。過去四年，AI 需求爆發式成長，大幅推升該公司價值，但若仍以 2022 年 AI 浪潮興起前的十年平均獲利作為比較基準，顯然難以合理反映輝達當前的真實價值。
高盛首席美股策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）今年 6 月接受訪問時則提出另一種觀點。儘管目前的席勒本益比水準隱含未來報酬可能為負，他仍預期標普 500 指數未來十年年化報酬可望達到 7%。
這是因為，史奈德認為企業高估值狀態可能維持更長時間。他指出，過去幾十年來企業利潤率持續走高，從 2000 年的 7% 一路升至目前約 13%。
Snider 表示：「這些利潤率似乎不太可能回落至長期平均水準，因此，認為估值倍數應該回歸長期平均值的假設，似乎也不是一個很有說服力的論點。」
paras_en: The Shiller P/E ratio, a key US stock market indicator, broke above 42 in July, reaching its highest level since the 2000 dot‑com bubble peak, sparking concerns that future returns could cool sharply. However, experts caution that a high valuation does not automatically mean a market crash; continued improvement in corporate profit margins and structural shifts such as AI could keep valuations elevated for longer, and investors should focus more on whether the fundamentals behind the high valuation can be sustained.

According to Business Insider, the Shiller P/E has long been favored by bearish investors and mainstream Wall Street strategists because of its historically accurate record in forecasting long‑term returns.

David Rosenberg, founder of Rosenberg Research and traditionally bearish, wrote in a recent client note that, excluding the dot‑com bubble period, the S&P 500 is currently at the "most expensive valuation in history."
A few years ago, former Goldman Sachs strategist David Kostin warned that a lofty Shiller P/E implies an annualized return of only about 3% over the next ten years.

Analysts note that although the Shiller P/E was not designed to predict short‑term market moves, market participants inevitably recall that the last time the indicator approached a similar high, a market collapse was imminent.
The report adds that even if systemic risk does not materialize in the short term, the prospect of "near‑zero returns over the next decade" still unsettles investors.

Nevertheless, analysts point out that the metric is not without controversy; its limitations lead many experts to be skeptical of the claim that "overvaluation inevitably leads to a crash," suggesting investors need not be overly worried.
Historical data reveal a clear flaw in the Shiller P/E: US equity valuations have stayed high for long periods while the index repeatedly hits new highs.

For example, in July 2021 the Shiller P/E was 38. Based on a 2020 study by Michael Finke, a wealth‑management professor at The American College of Financial Services, this implied an expected annualized return of only 1%‑2% for the S&P 500 over the next ten years.
Yet over the past five years the S&P 500 has risen 73% cumulatively, translating to an annualized return of over 14%, far above the low‑return scenario originally projected.

Analysts argue that unless an extreme event occurs that drags average returns down to the 1%‑2% range, exiting the market merely because valuations are high would likely incur a hefty opportunity cost.

A 2024 Fidelity research report supports this view, finding that ten‑year periods that start with high P/E ratios only underperform when major crises such as World War II or the financial crisis erupt, not because high valuation alone causes lower returns.

Analysts also warn that unless investors are within ten years of retirement or need to draw on funds soon, most people need not be overly concerned about elevated valuations; long‑term compounding of dividends usually offsets temporary return weakness.

Another limitation of the Shiller P/E is its heavy reliance on the past; because it compares current prices to a ten‑year rolling average of earnings, it often fails to capture rapid structural changes in the market.

Nvidia (NVDA) is a prime example. Over the past four years, explosive AI demand has dramatically boosted the company's value, yet using the pre‑AI‑boom ten‑year average earnings from 2022 as a benchmark does not fairly reflect Nvidia's current true worth.

Goldman Sachs chief US equity strategist Ben Snider, in a June interview, offered a different perspective. Although the current Shiller P/E level suggests future returns could be negative, he still expects the S&P 500 to deliver a 7% annualized return over the next decade.

Snider argues that high corporate valuations may persist longer than expected. He notes that corporate profit margins have risen steadily over the past decades, climbing from 7% in 2000 to roughly 13% today.

Snider said, "These profit margins seem unlikely to revert to long‑term average levels, so the assumption that valuation multiples should fall back to their historical averages is not a very persuasive argument."

items.title_en: US Midterm Election Could Be the Turning Point of the Stock Bull Market, Bank of America Warns AI Bubble May Burst
paras: 美國銀行策略團隊示警，這波牛市可能在數個月後遭遇重大考驗，而風險來源正是 11 月即將登場的期中選舉。
根據《Business Insider》報導，由哈奈特（Michael Hartnett）領軍的策略團隊在最新報告中指出，隨著 11 月期中選舉落幕，美股可能面臨一波「大幅」反轉風險。
該行近期發布給客戶的報告指出，此次選舉可能演變成一場「民粹資本主義與民粹社會主義之間的公投」，因此不排除民主黨全面拿下國會的可能性。
團隊在報告中建議投資人短期內應避開高風險資產，轉向防禦性投資部位，並看好黃金作為對沖工具，用以因應「K 型經濟」與選民對經濟不滿情緒所帶來的雙重風險。
所謂 K 型經濟，指的是高收入族群與中低收入家庭之間日益擴大的貧富差距。儘管股市與房市上漲讓高所得者財富持續累積，許多中低收入美國人卻正承受通膨升溫與就業市場疲軟的雙重壓力。
美銀策略師進一步分析，近期經濟成長主要仰賴股市上漲所帶動的財富效應。過去兩年間，投資人累積的市場獲利高達 9 兆美元，若股市出現逆轉，帳面財富縮水恐讓消費者轉趨保守，進而拖累整體經濟成長。
除了選舉變數，美銀也點出公債殖利率走升的潛在威脅。隨著投資人對通膨與美國財政前景的憂慮加深，殖利率若持續攀升，在最壞情況下恐嚴重壓抑風險性資產，甚至戳破外界擔憂已久的 AI 泡沫。
策略師表示：「每一輪繁榮與泡沫，最終往往都是由債券市場終結；一旦出現『殖利率走高、美元走弱』的警示事件，迫使財政政策急轉彎，以及資產配置從股票轉向債券，當前的泡沫就會結束。」
他們並將殖利率形容為目前最值得關注的「礦坑裡的金絲雀」。
事實上，殖利率已因通膨數據升溫而開始走高，但目前市場仍能消化這波漲勢。目前 10 年期美國公債殖利率約落在 4.67% 附近，高於投資人密切關注的 4.5% 心理關卡。
華爾街其他機構同樣預警，隨著期中選舉逼近，市場波動恐將加劇。
奧本海默（Oppenheimer）分析師先前即指出，在總統邁入第二任期的期中選舉年份，標普 500 指數往往會在第三季出現回檔修正。
高盛策略師的歷史數據則顯示，自 1974 年以來的所有期中選舉年，標普 500 指數從 8 月 1 日到 11 月投票日期間的報酬率中位數為 0％。
paras_en: Bank of America’s strategy team warns that this bull market could face a major test in a few months, with the risk coming from the upcoming November midterm elections.

According to Business Insider, the strategy team led by Michael Hartnett noted in its latest report that the US equity market could face a “significant” reversal risk once the November midterms conclude.

The bank’s recent client report says the election could turn into a referendum between populist capitalism and populist socialism, and therefore does not rule out the possibility of Democrats taking full control of Congress.

The team advises investors to steer clear of high‑risk assets in the short term, shift to defensive positions, and view gold favorably as a hedge against the dual risks of a “K‑shaped” economy and voter dissatisfaction with the economy.

A “K‑shaped” economy refers to the widening wealth gap between high‑income earners and middle‑to‑low‑income households; while stock and housing price gains continue to build wealth for the affluent, many middle‑ and low‑income Americans are feeling the twin pressures of rising inflation and a weak job market.

Bank of America strategists further analyze that recent economic growth has been largely driven by a wealth effect from rising stock prices. Over the past two years, investors have accumulated about $9 trillion in market gains, and a market reversal could shrink paper wealth, prompting consumers to become more cautious and dragging down overall economic growth.

Beyond the election variable, BofA also points to the potential threat of rising government‑bond yields. As investors grow more concerned about inflation and US fiscal outlook, continued yield increases could, in the worst case, severely suppress risk assets and even burst the long‑standing AI bubble concerns.

The strategists say, “Each cycle of prosperity and bubble ultimately ends in the bond market; once a ‘rising yields, weakening dollar’ warning materializes, it forces fiscal policy to pivot and asset allocation to shift from stocks to bonds, ending the current bubble.”
They describe yields as the most closely watched “canary in the coal mine” right now.

In fact, yields have already started to climb as inflation data heats up, but the market is still able to absorb the rise. The 10‑year US Treasury yield is currently around 4.67%, above the 4.5% psychological threshold investors watch closely.
Other Wall Street firms are issuing similar warnings, noting that market volatility could intensify as the midterms approach.
Oppenheimer analysts previously pointed out that in midterm election years when a president is in a second term, the S&P 500 often experiences a pull‑back correction in the third quarter.
Goldman Sachs strategists’ historical data show that for every midterm election year since 1974, the median return of the S&P 500 from August 1 to the November voting date has been 0 %.

items.title: 美股上漲卻更「便宜」了？標普500漲22%估值反降、企業獲利成大推手
items.title_en: US Stocks Rise, But Become Cheaper? S&P 500 Up 22% as Valuation Falls, Earnings Drive the Market
paras: 在「縮水式通膨」（shrinkflation）當道的年代，消費者早已習慣商品份量悄悄縮水、內容物偷工減料的失望滋味，同樣的價錢，買到的巧克力花生醬杯裡，可能只剩「巧克力糖」與「花生醬奶油」充數。然而，在股票市場上，投資人此刻卻意外享受到「加量不加價」的待遇。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，過去一年，標普 500 指數大漲 22%，但股票估值非但沒有跟著墊高，反而下滑。
根據彭博資訊統計，該指數的預期本益比已從 22.1 倍降至 20 倍左右。換言之，投資人如今花更少的錢，卻能買到更有價值的東西。
分析指出，造成這種現象的關鍵，在於企業「獲利」的成長速度，明顯超越「股價」的漲幅。
根據 FactSet 統計，第二季財報季的表現可謂相當驚人，有 86% 的企業財報獲利優於市場預期，高於 78% 的平均水準；此外，標普 500 指數成分股第二季獲利較去年同期大幅成長 50.4%。
不過，這波獲利榮景並非僅靠人工智慧（AI）題材撐場。Evercore ISI 的 Julian Emanuel 指出：「第二季財報進一步印證科技與能源產業的強勁表現，但更令人意外的是，獲利成長的力道已廣泛擴散至各產業及產業內的不同領域。」
更重要的是，這波強勁表現預料仍可延續。分析師向來有在新一季開始前下修獲利預期的「慣例」，但這一次卻出現反常情況，市場不僅沒有下調預測，反而將第三季獲利預期上修 0.3%。
然而，這股「一路看漲」的氛圍，也讓部分投資專家開始警覺。Verdence Capital Advisors 首席投資長 Megan Horneman 坦言，這季財報表現確實驚豔，但問題在於「調升獲利預期似乎沒有盡頭」，這種現象恐怕透露出市場已出現「自滿心理」。
不過，也有市場人士對這些獲利的「品質」抱持疑慮。做空投資人 Jim Chanos 認為，AI 支出的會計處理方式可能在一定程度上美化企業獲利，原因在於設備供應商能更快認列營收，但採購設備的企業則需要較長時間才能將相關支出反映在費用中。
這或許能部分解釋，為何科技產業的本益比降幅較整體大盤更為明顯。不過，獲利成長並非僅集中在 AI 相關產業，整體市場的企業獲利表現相當廣泛。就連非 AI 產業，例如民生必需品類股，過去一年股價也有所上漲，且並未同步推升估值水準。
也有觀點認為，企業獲利成長幅度過於強勁，已使短期估值指標失去參考意義。
Rosenberg Research 的 David Rosenberg 指出，Robert Shiller 提出的「席勒本益比」（CAPE），也就是以標普 500 指數當前價格，對比過去 10 年平均獲利的估值指標，目前已升至網路泡沫時期以來少見的高位。
不過，遠期本益比（Forward P/E）與 CAPE 之間的落差，其實透露出另一個訊息：市場預期企業未來一年的獲利，將遠高於過去 10 年的平均水準，讓人不禁反思，以「網路泡沫時代」的獲利基準來衡量今日的企業表現，是否本身就已經不合時宜？
不過，市場疑慮並未因此完全消散。
儘管亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 與 Google 母公司 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 等 AI 相關投資大戶，因為從雲端業務中賺進可觀營收，使科技股自七月低點反彈約 12%，但分析師提醒，這並不代表企業投入的每一分 AI 支出，最終都能轉化為實質報酬。
paras_en: In the era of 'shrinkflation', consumers have grown accustomed to the disappointment of goods shrinking in size and quality while prices remain the same. However, investors in the stock market are experiencing the opposite - 'more for less'.
According to Bloomberg, the S&P 500 index has risen 22% over the past year, but stock valuations have not followed suit, instead falling.
According to Bloomberg data, the index's expected price-to-earnings ratio has dropped from 22.1 to around 20. This means investors are now paying less for more valuable stocks.
Analysts attribute this phenomenon to the growth rate of corporate earnings, which has outpaced stock price gains.

According to FactSet, 86% of companies in the second quarter reported earnings that beat market expectations, exceeding the average of 78%. The S&P 500 index's constituent stocks also saw a 50.4% year-over-year increase in earnings in the second quarter.

However, this earnings boom is not solely driven by AI-related themes. Evercore ISI's Julian Emanuel notes that the second-quarter earnings reports have further confirmed the strong performance of the tech and energy sectors, but more surprisingly, earnings growth has spread to various industries and sub-sectors.

More importantly, this strong performance is expected to continue. Analysts have traditionally lowered earnings expectations before the start of a new quarter, but this time, the market has not only avoided lowering expectations but has even raised third-quarter earnings expectations by 0.3%.

However, this 'one-way bet' atmosphere has also raised concerns among some investment experts. Verdence Capital Advisors' Chief Investment Officer Megan Horneman notes that this quarter's earnings reports have been impressive, but the problem lies in the fact that 'the upward revision of earnings expectations seems to have no end', which may indicate that the market has become complacent.

However, some market participants have raised concerns about the 'quality' of these earnings. Short-seller Jim Chanos believes that the accounting treatment of AI-related expenses may have artificially inflated corporate earnings, as equipment suppliers can quickly recognize revenue, while companies that purchase equipment take longer to reflect related expenses in their costs.

This may help explain why the tech sector's price-to-earnings ratio has fallen more sharply than the overall market. However, earnings growth is not limited to AI-related industries, and the overall market's corporate earnings performance has been quite broad. Even non-AI industries, such as consumer staples, have seen their stock prices rise over the past year without a corresponding increase in valuation.
Some argue that corporate earnings growth has become so strong that short-term valuation metrics have lost their relevance.

Rosenberg Research's David Rosenberg notes that the 'Shiller P/E' (CAPE), which compares the current price of the S&P 500 index to its average earnings over the past 10 years, has risen to a level not seen since the dot-com bubble.

However, the gap between the forward P/E and CAPE actually reveals another message: the market expects corporate earnings to be significantly higher than their 10-year average in the coming year, raising questions about whether today's corporate performance is being measured against an outdated benchmark.
However, market concerns have not been completely alleviated.

Despite Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) - parent company of Google - AI-related heavyweights experiencing a 12% rebound from their July lows due to cloud business revenue, analysts caution that not every dollar invested in AI will necessarily translate to tangible returns.

paras_en: On August 10, the Taiwan stock market pre-market news reported that the US stock market's four major indexes closed higher on Friday (7th), with the Nasdaq index surging 2.56%. According to market analysts, memory-related stocks such as Nanya Technology, Winbond, and ASE, as well as ABF Substrate manufacturer Jingsheng, may be included in the constituent stocks. The new regulations make significant adjustments to the disposal period, matching interval, and attention stock threshold. Stocks currently in the disposal period, including those of Hotai Motor, will be subject to the new regulations, and their disposal periods will end on August 7th, with normal trading resuming on August 10th.

In response to the market's surprise at the company's second-quarter sales gross margin of 87.42% and operating profit margin of 82.08%, Wang emphasized that this was the result of the company's long-term accumulation of technology and innovation.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange's new regulations on disposal stocks will take effect on August 10th, shortening the disposal period and changing the matching interval to 2 minutes. Ten listed stocks, including those of Hotai Motor, will be released from disposal ahead of schedule.
Huahong Pharmaceutical updated its AOP arbitration case, and the second phase of the results is being discussed, with a proposal to withdraw the arbitration judgment.
Wistron's first-half earnings exceeded 15 times its capital, a record high for the same period. The company's capital expenditure in the second half of the year is expected to reach $942 million.
Chiah Chyun's second-quarter gross margin was surprisingly high, with Executive Vice President Wang Junqiang attributing it to the company's extreme management and IP value.

Kingchamp's Executive Director Chen Yanan stated that the demand for AI will drive the company's growth in the second half of the year, with a 'dive and jump' trend expected in the fourth quarter. The company's new factory in Vietnam is expected to start production in the fourth quarter.

Taiwan's exports in July reached $7.53 billion, the third-highest on record. The market is watching the export performance in August, which is expected to challenge the longest 34-day streak, with a full-year target of $80 billion.
Zhen Ding Technology stated that the PMIC shortage has returned to a state similar to that during the pandemic, and the increase in wafer supply will be limited next year.
ASE's revenue in July was NT$27.162 billion, a new high, with a year-over-year increase of 263% in the first seven months.
TSMC's second-half operations are expected to be strong, but the company warned to be cautious of the inflection point in demand.

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉台指期夜盤重回4萬5大關 MSCI季度調整台股權重恐遭小幅調降
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: Futures Reclaim 45,000 Mark as MSCI Quarterly Weight Adjustments May Slightly Reduce Taiwan Weight
paras: 美股四大指數上周五 (7 日) 收紅，費半指數大漲 2.56%，台指期上漲 736 點，以 45033 點作收，提前站上 4 萬 5 大關；台股 8 月首周大漲 1106 點後，本周將迎來 MSCI 季度調整，以及處置股新制正式周一 (10 日) 正式實施、以及台股 7 月營收及半年報陸續公布下，有望展開進一步反彈。
MSCI 台股權重季度調整預定 13 日凌晨公布，投顧點名，記憶體族群南亞科、華邦電、群聯，以及 ABF 載板廠景碩等 4 檔個股，有機會入列成分股；台股 7 月下跌 3006 點，出現轉弱，市值一個月內由 4.6 兆美元降至至 4.3 兆美元，台股權重有可能出現小幅調降。
台新投顧總經理黃文清表示，從整體消息面觀察，美伊戰爭有望達成協議或是告一段落，至少短期內看來擴大機會不大，加上美國上周公告 7 月份非農就業人數意外不增反減，市場預估聯準會 (Fed) 在 9 月升息機率下滑，標普 500 指數雖創歷史新高，但在 AI 產業業績強勁表現下，美股仍有機會持續往上走，也有望激勵台股向上續攻。
在台股強勢族群上，黃文清表示，投資人仍可關注及留意 AI 為主的族群類股，其他包括半導體相關設備、材料、伺服器導軌及 AI 伺服器等相關題材類股。
另針對證交所近期針對處置股修正條例，新制將針對處置天數、撮合間隔時間所短以及注意股票門檻進行大幅度調整，於周一 (8 月 10 日) 起正式實施。
對此，黃文清也說，證交所、櫃買中心針對處置關禁閉股票新措施，能夠放寬處置、縮短股票遭官緊閉時間，當然有利於成交更加順利，對台股未來走勢及成交量能放大有正面助益，有望使市場交易能更加活絡、也更加順利。

觀察外資一周來主要買超，包括為主動統一升級 50(00403A-TW) 買超 23.6 萬張、元大台灣 50 反 1(00632R-TW) 買超 22.5 萬張、主動統一台股增長 (00981A-TW) 買 16,4 萬張、凱基台灣 TOP50(009816-TW) 買 14.8 萬張、元大台灣 50 正 2(00631L-TW)11.8 萬張、元大台灣 50(0050-TW)11.6 萬張、主動復華未來 50(00991A)8.7 萬張，買超 10 名中，前 7 名已主動、被動及反向 ETF 居多。
paras_en: U.S. major indices closed higher last Friday (the 7th), with the Nasdaq soaring 2.56%. Taiwan futures rose 736 points to finish at 45,033, briefly crossing the 45,000 threshold. After a 1,106‑point surge in the first week of August, the market looks set for the MSCI quarterly rebalancing, the new disposal‑stock rules taking effect on Monday (the 10th), and the rollout of July revenue and half‑year reports, all of which could spark further upside.

MSCI’s quarterly adjustment of Taiwan’s weight is slated for early morning on the 13th. Analysts highlighted four stocks—memory‑chip makers Nanya Technology, Winbond Electronics, Phison Electronics, and ABF‑listed carrier board maker Jingsheng—that could be added to the index. Taiwan’s market fell 3,006 points in July, showing signs of weakness, and its market‑cap slipped from $4.6 trillion to $4.3 trillion within a month, raising the possibility of a modest weight reduction.

Taiwan’s Taishin Securities chief economist Huang Wen‑qing said that, overall, the outlook looks better as the US‑China conflict may reach an agreement or at least pause, limiting short‑term escalation. Moreover, the U.S. Labor Department reported a surprising drop in July non‑farm payrolls, prompting expectations that the Fed’s September rate‑hike odds have fallen. Although the S&P 500 hit a record high, strong AI earnings could keep U.S. equities climbing and, in turn, buoy Taiwan’s market.
Regarding the market’s leading sectors, Huang advised investors to keep an eye on AI‑focused stocks as well as related themes such as semiconductor equipment, materials, server rails and AI servers.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange has revised its rules on disposal‑stock handling. The new regime will significantly tighten the allowed holding period, matching intervals and stock‑price thresholds, and will be implemented starting Monday, August 10.

Huang added that the exchange’s and OTC market’s new measures to relax disposal restrictions and shorten the time stocks are locked down should improve trading flow. He expects the changes to boost market activity and volume, providing a positive lift to Taiwan’s future market trajectory.

Foreign investors’ net‑buy activity over the past week was led by several ETFs: Unified Active 50 (00403A‑TW) bought 236,000 shares, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW) bought 225,000, Unified Active Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW) bought 164,000, KGI Taiwan TOP50 (009816‑TW) bought 148,000, Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L‑TW) bought 118,000, Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) bought 116,000, and Fuhua Future 50 (00991A) bought 87,000. Among the top ten net‑buyers, the majority were active, passive and inverse ETFs.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉磷化銦需求持續看旺 聯亞周漲41.41％站上所有均線
items.title_en: Hot Stock: InP Demand Remains Strong as Lian Ya Soars 41.41% This Week, Surpassing All Moving Averages
paras: 三五族光通訊股聯亞 (3081-TW) 受惠於光通訊 AI 及數據資料中心需求加溫，加上磷化銦 (InP) 基板缺貨題材挹注、7 月營收亮眼，連噴 4 根漲停板，周漲 41.41％，不僅周 K 收紅，量增價揚，不僅站上所有均線，股價也收復 2,000 元大關，創近 1 個多月來新高。
聯亞因數據中心需求升溫、光通訊產品出貨增加，以及市場對供應鏈重組的期待同步發酵，7 月營收 5.01 億元，月增 19.19%、年增 176.54%，累計前 7 個月營收 26.27 億元，年增 120.9%。
聯亞除了 7 月營收亮眼，上周也受市場題材追捧，外媒指出，美國 (FCC) 正研擬基於國家安全理由，限制美國 AI 資料中心使用中國公司製造的光收發模組，降低中國設備滲透美國 AI 資料中心風險，期望最快在今 (2026) 年正式上路，外界也解讀，中國光收發模組供應受限，有望轉單至台廠供應鏈。
此外，光通訊大廠 Lumentum 執行長近期也示警，AI 資料中心對磷化銦雷射需求暴增，出貨缺口達 30% 以上，也讓聯亞成為資金關注亮點。
聯亞資料通訊產品占營收約 80%-85%，絕大部分為矽光子模組使用的 CW Laser，主要透過下游光模組廠代工，出貨給美國超大規模雲端服務業者，本周 8 月 12 日即將舉行法說會，屆時外界有望更了解未來公司產品布局。
paras_en: Lian Ya (3081‑TW), a 3‑5‑group optical communications stock, benefited from warming demand for optical‑communication AI and data centers, plus a shortage theme for indium phosphide (InP) substrates and impressive July revenue. The stock hit four consecutive daily limit‑up moves, gaining 41.41% for the week, closing the week in the green with higher volume and price, breaking above all moving averages and reclaiming the NT$2,000 level – a new high not seen in over a month.

Lian Ya’s July revenue reached NT$5.01 billion, up 19.19% month‑over‑month and 176.54% year‑over‑year, while cumulative revenue for the first seven months hit NT$26.27 billion, a 120.9% increase year‑on‑year, driven by hotter data‑center demand, increased shipments of optical‑communication products, and market expectations of supply‑chain restructuring.

In addition to its strong July sales, Lian Ya was buoyed last week by market themes. Foreign media reported that the U.S. FCC is drafting rules, citing national‑security concerns, to restrict U.S. AI data centers from using optical transceiver modules made by Chinese companies, aiming to reduce Chinese equipment penetration in U.S. AI data centers as early as this year (2026). Analysts interpret the potential limitation on Chinese transceiver supplies as an opportunity for Taiwanese manufacturers to capture the redirected orders.

Furthermore, Lumentum’s CEO recently warned that AI data centers are seeing a surge in demand for indium‑phosphide lasers, with a shipment shortfall exceeding 30%, highlighting Lian Ya as a focal point for investor attention.

Products related to data communications account for roughly 80%–85% of Lian Ya’s revenue, the vast majority being continuous‑wave (CW) lasers used in silicon‑photonic modules. These are primarily manufactured by downstream optical‑module foundries and shipped to large U.S. cloud service providers. The company will hold its earnings briefing on August 12, where investors expect to learn more about its future product roadmap.

items.title: 飛捷Q3接單能見度明朗 拉貨力道顯著優於去年同期
items.title_en: FeiJie Sees Clear Q3 Order Visibility, Shipping Strength Far Exceeds Same Period Last Year
paras: 工業電腦廠飛捷 (6206-TW) 表示，第三季接單能見度明朗，整體拉貨力道顯著優於去年同期，此外，Vision AI 軟體子公司 Berry AI 與 Angible 均已達規模化商用階段，預計下半年也呈現倍數成長。
飛捷表示，持續拓展垂直應用市場，成本端則推進多元採購與供應鏈韌性布局，確保關鍵料件穩定供貨，發揮採購彈性以鞏固整體獲利品質，下半年整體營運可望延續累計營收年增成長趨勢。
此外，飛捷軟體營收下半年量能預期倍數放大，持續朝軟體子公司全年營收占比 5% 的目標邁進，常態性軟體營收能有效平衡硬體設計製造本業的淡旺季起伏，下半年整體營運可望延續累計營收年增成長趨勢。
目前飛捷三家軟體子公司業務進展加速，專注於 UEM (Unified Endpoint Management) 統一端點管理軟體平台的 Inefi，以及聚焦零售 Vision AI 解決方案的 Angible，上半年營收皆已超越去年全年表現。
主攻餐飲 Vision AI 應用的 Berry AI，上半年營收則為去年同期三倍，目前在餐飲場域資料累積、Vision AI 辨識模型與實際營運情境整合上，已逐步形成差異化技術門檻，並展現後續規模化導入的市場潛力。
paras_en: FeiJie (6206-TW), an industrial computer manufacturer, said its order visibility for the third quarter is clear and its overall shipping strength is significantly better than the same period last year. In addition, its Vision AI software subsidiary Berry AI and Angible have both reached a scale‑up commercial stage and are expected to show multiple‑fold growth in the second half of the year.

FeiJie said it continues to expand into vertical application markets while advancing diversified procurement and supply‑chain resilience on the cost side to ensure stable supply of key components. By leveraging procurement flexibility, it aims to solidify overall profit quality, and the second‑half operation is expected to continue the year‑over‑year revenue growth trend.

Furthermore, FeiJie's software revenue is expected to multiply in volume in the second half, moving toward the goal of software subsidiaries contributing 5% of total annual revenue. Recurring software revenue can effectively smooth the seasonal fluctuations of its hardware design and manufacturing core business, allowing the second‑half operation to sustain cumulative revenue growth year over year.

Currently, the three software subsidiaries of FeiJie are accelerating business progress. Inefi focuses on a Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) software platform, while Angible concentrates on retail Vision AI solutions; both posted first‑half revenues that already exceeded the entire previous year’s performance.

Berry AI, which targets Vision AI applications in the food‑service sector, achieved first‑half revenue three times that of the same period last year. It is gradually building differentiated technical barriers through data accumulation in dining venues, Vision AI recognition models, and integration with real‑world operational scenarios, demonstrating market potential for subsequent large‑scale deployment.

items.title: 印能科技卡位雙陣營 今年營收估倍增、產能再增3成
items.title_en: InnoTech Positions Itself in Dual Camps, Revenue Expected to Double This Year, Capacity to Increase by Another 30%
paras: 印能科技 (7734-TW) 持續擴大客戶版圖，近期除受惠台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) CoWoS 及 SoIC 等需求放量，也傳出深耕多年的英特爾 (INTC-US) EMIB 平台開始出貨，隨著兩大晶圓代工陣營同步推進先進封裝，印能科技今年營運可望逐季走高，法人估，印能今年營收將翻倍，明年動能可望再更強。
印能科技目前設備月產能約 40 台，為因應客戶需求持續升溫，已啟動新一波擴產計畫，將原先廠房三樓空間建置為生產區，月產能可望增加約 10 多台，整體產能提升約 30-40%。
印能科技近年隨著台積電 CoWoS 製程產能不斷擴張，營收高速成長，且受惠台積電未來持續穩健擴充產能，印能需求也跟著提升，同時也傳出切入 SoIC 供應鏈，使用印能第三代設備，今年下半年已開始陸續出貨。
市場預估，台積電今年 SoIC 產能將在短短三年內增長 3 倍，今年底月產能約 2 萬片，明年可望倍增至 4 萬片，後年更上看 8 萬片，受惠客戶逐步拉升產能，印能相關設備明年放量幅度將更顯著。
隨著全球先進封裝產能緊俏，英特爾 EMIB 製程也獲得多家終端客戶青睞，傳出拿下多筆訂單，並啟動未來數年擴產計畫，印能科技耕耘 EMIB 製程多年，相關設備已在今年上半年少量出貨，後續可望隨英特爾 EMIB 產品推進而逐步放量，成為新動能。
除了既有先進封裝技術，印能科技也積極切入 CPO、FOPLP 及翹曲控制等新應用，尤其近來由於晶片及光罩尺寸持續放大，翹曲問題也成為新挑戰，印能科技推出 WSAS 產品因應，目前已在客戶驗證階段，最快第四季有機會取得進展。
paras_en: InnoTech (7734-TW) continues to expand its customer base. Recently it has benefited from increased demand for TSMC (2330-TW) (TSM-US) CoWoS and SoIC, and it is reported that the long‑time Intel (INTC-US) EMIB platform it has been cultivating is now shipping. As both major wafer‑foundry camps push advanced packaging forward, InnoTech’s operations are expected to rise quarter by quarter this year. Analysts estimate InnoTech’s revenue will double this year, with even stronger momentum anticipated next year.

InnoTech’s current equipment capacity is about 40 units per month. To meet rising customer demand, it has launched a new expansion phase, converting space on the third floor of its plant into a production area. This should add roughly ten more units per month, boosting total capacity by about 30‑40%.

In recent years, as TSMC’s CoWoS production capacity has continuously expanded, InnoTech’s revenue has grown rapidly. Benefiting from TSMC’s steady capacity expansion, demand for InnoTech’s equipment has risen, and the company is also reported to have entered the SoIC supply chain, using its third‑generation equipment, with shipments beginning in the second half of this year.

The market forecasts that TSMC’s SoIC capacity will triple within three years. By the end of this year, monthly capacity is expected to reach about 20,000 wafers, doubling to 40,000 wafers next year and potentially 80,000 wafers the year after, as customers gradually increase output. Consequently, InnoTech‑related equipment is expected to see a more pronounced volume increase next year.

With global advanced‑packaging capacity in short supply, Intel’s EMIB process has attracted multiple end‑customers, securing several orders and launching a multi‑year expansion plan. InnoTech has been developing EMIB technology for years, and its related equipment saw limited shipments in the first half of this year. Further volume growth is expected as Intel’s EMIB products advance, providing a new growth driver.

Beyond existing advanced‑packaging technologies, InnoTech is actively entering new applications such as CPO, FOPLP, and warp control. As chip and mask sizes continue to grow, warp has become a fresh challenge. InnoTech introduced its WSAS product to address this and is currently in customer verification, with the possibility of progress as early as the fourth quarter.

items.title: 記憶體大漲推升顯示卡迎第三波漲價潮 板卡廠平均出貨單價激增進補
items.title_en: Memory Surge Drives Third Wave of GPU Price Hikes, Board Makers See Average Shipment Prices Jump
paras: 由於記憶體價格持續走揚，顯示卡市場迎來今年第三波漲價潮，輝達等晶片大廠陸續調漲顯示卡晶片套裝售價約 2-3 成，帶動全球零售通路與批發市場價格急劇攀升，可望進一步推升華碩 (2357-TW)、微星 (2377-TW)、技嘉 (2376-TW) 等板卡廠平均出貨單價，為下半年獲利表現注入補丸。
全球最大電子產品批發市場深圳華強北近期出現顯卡價格一日一價急漲現象，部分熱門與高階型號數日內上漲人民幣數百元至上千元，漲幅超過三成，甚至連二手市場價格也同步走高，顯卡製造商微星已正式跟進華碩與技嘉腳步調高顯示卡出貨價格，最高調漲幅度突破 20%。
針對記憶體成本大漲對後市的影響，微星表示雖然記憶體供貨能見度僅約一個月且成本攀升，導致今年消費性市場出貨量可能下滑 10% 至 20%，但在同業嚴控毛利率不殺價且單價提升帶動下，對整體獲利表現仍有實質幫助。
技嘉則指出記憶體價格上漲確實對消費端需求造成壓力，但隨著人工智慧應用持續普及，將有效推升既有電腦設備的換機需求，下半年主機板與顯示卡業務展望仍保持審慎樂觀。
雖然研究機構預警記憶體合約價下半年仍有大幅上揚風險，且晶片原廠針對部分高成本高階顯卡採取延後上市或調整產能策略，但各板卡廠積極嚴控產品毛利率並隨時調整產品報價，市場預期價格調整效應將持續觀察至年底購物旺季，整體高附加價值產品組合將持續支撐板卡廠營運韌性。
paras_en: Due to the continued rise in memory prices, the graphics‑card market is experiencing its third wave of price hikes this year. Major chip makers such as Nvidia are gradually raising the price of GPU chip packages by about 20‑30%, which has sent retail and wholesale prices soaring worldwide and is expected to lift the average shipment price for board makers like Asus (2357‑TW), MSI (2377‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW), bolstering profit performance in the second half of the year.

Shenzhen’s Huaqiangbei, the world’s largest electronics wholesale market, has recently seen GPU prices jump dramatically day by day. Some popular and high‑end models have risen by several hundred to over a thousand yuan within a few days, an increase of more than 30%. Even second‑hand market prices have climbed. GPU maker MSI has officially followed Asus and Gigabyte in raising its shipment prices, with the highest increase exceeding 20%.

Regarding the impact of the memory cost surge, MSI said that although memory supply visibility is only about a month and costs are climbing, which could cause consumer‑market shipments this year to fall 10‑20%, the industry’s strict control of gross margins and the rise in unit prices will still provide a tangible boost to overall profitability.

Gigabyte noted that the memory price rise does put pressure on consumer demand, but the continued proliferation of artificial‑intelligence applications will effectively drive replacement demand for existing computer equipment. Consequently, the outlook for motherboard and GPU sales in the second half remains cautiously optimistic.

Although research firms warn that contract memory prices could still rise sharply in the second half and chip makers are delaying launches or adjusting capacity for some high‑cost, high‑end GPUs, board makers are tightly managing product gross margins and adjusting pricing as needed. The market expects price‑adjustment effects to be monitored through the year‑end shopping season, and the overall high‑value‑added product mix will continue to support the resilience of board makers’ operations.

items.title: 繼巨大護盤之後 自行車廠明係10日起執行買回1000張庫藏股
items.title_en: Bicycle manufacturer Ming Hsi to buy back 1,000 shares from October 10th
paras: 繼巨大 (9921-TW) 之後，自行車廠明係 (6804-TW) 也決議在每股 23 元以下，自 10 日起執行買 1000 張庫藏股護盤，用途在於轉讓給員工，巨大與明係的買回庫藏股，都是掛牌以來的首度執行。
明係決議自 10 日起執行的買回庫藏股措施，將在每股 23-16 元買 1000 張張庫藏股，股價低於 16 元元也得繼續買進，如買滿 1000 張，將占股本的 2.11%。

The company's net profit after tax was NT$97.7 million, up 32.15% from the previous quarter, and it turned a profit from a loss in the same period last year. The earnings per share for the quarter were NT$0.21.

The company's net profit after tax was NT$171.7 million, turning a profit from a loss in the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$0.38.

The earnings per share for the quarter were NT$1.62.
